purpose: Reserve genuinely untouched papers for testing whether v1.2 generalizes beyond the nine-paper development set.
contamination_rule: No paper may enter this manifest after its full text, figures, expected experiments, or expected outcomes have been inspected during v1.2 implementation.
legacy_split_note: The gold_v1 development papers have already informed diagnosis or implementation and are not considered untouched, regardless of their older split label.

separation_of_duties.selection_and_gold_annotation: human review before any v1.2 run
separation_of_duties.evaluation: may read only after development implementation is frozen
